title: tsuji channel log record
description: 1 message = 1 line in a tsuji channel JSON Lines file. v1 schema.

id.description: ULID. Crockford Base32, 26 chars. Lex-order equals time-order.

ts.description: RFC3339 / ISO 8601 timestamp at send time. UTC recommended.

from.description: Sender label. Non-empty, no newline, up to 64 chars.

body.description: Plain text body. May contain newlines. Non-empty.
